# Invented N4 binding fixture

`invented.xml` contains one made-up PubMed-shaped record, no patient material and no real paper.
The `.invalid` DOCTYPE is tolerated but never fetched. The qualifier builds gzip, MD5 sidecars,
a 1,334-member baseline listing, seven update entries and minimal MeSH-shaped XML entirely in
memory. Only the prescribed three baseline and two latest update files have payload routes.
No network or live NLM dataset is needed. Pins are recorded before any native child-area writes.
